featured.title: Amanotes Music Games

featured.summary: Built and supported multiple music game projects across Unity, Cocos Creator, PlayCanvas, and HTML5, including titles and prototypes such as Beat Drum, Guitar Fire, Dancing Wings, Flippy Tiles, Tap Tap Son Tung, Tiles Hop, Beat Jumper, and related music gameplay experiments.
featured.impact: Brings long-term domain depth in rhythm/music gameplay, fast prototyping, SDK integration, cross-platform delivery, and production support at Amanotes.
highlights: Built and supported rhythm gameplay across multiple Amanotes music titles and prototypes.
Worked across Unity, Cocos Creator, PlayCanvas, mobile, and HTML5 delivery.
Handled SDK integration, production debugging, optimization, and partner support.

featured.title: Blood Field / Cỏ Máu
featured.summary: Co-created Cỏ Máu with TEGA Studio, an indie team founded by me and colleagues, as a Vietnamese first-person horror game inspired by rural ghost stories, local atmosphere, and the ambition to bring Vietnamese cultural identity into games.
featured.impact: A stronger public proof point than a normal prototype: covered by Thanh Niên, released on Steam, and picked up by multiple YouTube gameplay and streamer videos, showing both production initiative and community interest.
highlights: Co-founded TEGA Studio with colleagues to build an original Vietnamese horror IP outside day-job production work.
Developed the project in Unity for PC/Steam, with 3D, atmosphere, interaction, and horror gameplay pipelines.
Earned press coverage and community attention, including coverage from Thanh Niên and multiple YouTube playthroughs.

featured.title: Tree Studios Game Prototypes
featured.summary: Contributed as a game developer on Tree Studios showcase projects including Knight Saga, Golden Mirage, and LIL' TREE GANGZ Playground Game. Focused on turning strong art direction and concept packs into playable Unity experiences with clear gameplay flow, scene composition, UI integration, and prototype polish.
featured.impact: Demonstrates the ability to collaborate with artists, read concept-heavy briefs, implement game feel quickly, and present prototypes in a format that recruiters and stakeholders can evaluate visually.
highlights: Translated art-heavy concepts into playable Unity prototype experiences.
Implemented gameplay flow, scene composition, UI integration, and interaction polish.
Collaborated with artists and presented work through visual public showcases.
